questions.question: Whom does Psalm 128 call blessed?
options: Everyone who is rich and gives to the poor
Everyone who is mighty and wins in battle
Everyone who is wise and counsels the king
Everyone who fears the LORD and walks in his ways
questions.answer: Everyone who fears the LORD and walks in his ways

questions.question: To what is the man's wife compared?
options: A fountain flowing in the courtyard
A wall standing firm around the home
A lamp burning bright through the night
A vine yielding fruit within the house
questions.answer: A vine yielding fruit within the house

questions.question: The psalm pictures children like olive shoots around the table.
Blessed is everyone who _____ the LORD, who walks in his ways!
You shall eat the fruit of your _____; you shall be blessed.
